scope.completenessPolicy: This file contains the selected panel, every descendant control and popup item, plus the application/window/ribbon/tab ancestors needed to retain a valid hierarchy.
scope.locationModel: Resolve controls by application/window/ribbon/tab/panel ancestry, stable control IDs, region, and sibling order. Pixel coordinates and transient popup bounds must be detected from the current screenshot rather than hard-coded.

semantics.description: Provides the AutoCAD Ribbon control named Insert.
Provides the available Detect and Convert variants. Use its explicit menu trigger to choose a variant.
Executes the current or default Detect and Convert variant without opening the menu.
Opens the Detect and Convert menu without executing its primary action.
semantics.result: The Detect and Convert popup menu becomes visible.

semantics.description: Contains the selectable Detect and Convert variants owned by this split button.
Identifies objects in the drawing that can be converted into blocks.
Identifies matching instances of an object to convert to blocks.
Creates a block definition from selected objects
Opens the block definition in the Block Editor
Provides the available Edit Attributes variants. Use its explicit menu trigger to choose a variant.
Executes the current or default Edit Attributes variant without opening the menu.
Opens the Edit Attributes menu without executing its primary action.
semantics.result: The Edit Attributes popup menu becomes visible.

semantics.description: Contains the selectable Edit Attributes variants owned by this split button.
Edits attributes in a block reference
Edits the variable attributes of  a block individually or globally
Replaces an existing block with a specified block.
Creates an attribute definition for storing data in a block
Manages the attributes for a selected block definition
Updates block references with new and changed attributes from a specified block definition
Opens or changes the Attribute Display Drop-down selection.
semantics.result: The Attribute Display Drop-down setting changes to the selected option.

semantics.description: Sets the insertion base point for the current drawing
